note: GCSE track (Year 11) for Gan Ainm, drafted by Claude in Ulster Irish for Dáithí Murray's sign-off. Same builder format as year8.json plus a question chain (qrows maps each question to the rows that answer it), pattern boxes ([ ] marks the letters that change), a basic/better/best ladder ([ ] marks the new words) and role plays.

builders.title: Mé féin agus mo theaghlach
builders.teaches: Introducing yourself and your family; mo + séimhiú (mo dheartháir, mo theaghlach) and m' before a vowel (m'athair); beirt with no séimhiú on d, t, s (beirt deartháireacha); comparing with níos sine / níos óige; giving a reason with mar; Deir mo chairde go bhfuil mé ...

sprioc.ga: Tá mé ag foghlaim le mé féin agus mo theaghlach a chur in aithne.
sprioc.en: I am learning to introduce myself and my family.

sprioc.ga: Tá mé ag foghlaim le barúil a thabhairt agus fáth a lua.
sprioc.en: I am learning to give an opinion and a reason.

questions: Cad é an t-ainm atá ort?
Cá mhéad duine atá i do theaghlach?
Cé hiad na daoine i do theaghlach?
An réitíonn tú go maith le do theaghlach?
Cad é a dhéanann sibh le chéile ag an deireadh seachtaine?

columns.ga: sa bhliain dhá mhíle is a deich
sa bhliain dhá mhíle is a haon déag
mar tá muid cosúil le chéile
mar bíonn muid ag gáire le chéile
mar is maith linn na rudaí céanna
columns.en: because we like the same things

columns.ga: Deir mo chairde go bhfuil mé
columns.en: My friends say that I am

examples: Is mise Conor agus tá mé cúig bliana déag d'aois.
Tá cúigear i mo theaghlach: mo mhamaí, mo dhaidí, beirt deartháireacha agus mé féin.
Réitím go maith le mo dheartháir mar is maith linn na rudaí céanna.

patterns.title: Mo agus séimhiú
patterns.question: Cad é a tharlaíonn don fhocal i ndiaidh mo? Cad chuige nach n-athraíonn leabhar ná athair ar an dóigh chéanna?
patterns.questionEn: What happens to the word after mo? Why do leabhar and athair not change in the same way?
patterns.rule: Mo puts a h after the first letter (séimhiú): mo dheartháir. L, n and r never take h: mo leabhar. Before a vowel, mo becomes m': m'athair.

ladder.en: There are five people in my family.
ladder.label: Bunúsach

ladder.ga: Tá cúigear i mo theaghlach[: mo mhamaí, mo dhaidí, beirt deartháireacha agus mé féin].
ladder.en: There are five people in my family: my mum, my dad, two brothers and me.
ladder.label: Níos fearr

ladder.ga: Tá cúigear i mo theaghlach. [Réitím go han-mhaith le mo dheartháir is óige mar is maith linn na rudaí céanna, ach caithfidh mé a rá go mbíonn muid ag argóint faoin teilifís ó am go ham.]
ladder.en: There are five people in my family. I get on very well with my youngest brother because we like the same things, but I have to say that we argue about the television from time to time.
ladder.label: Is fearr

roleplays.title: Cara nua
roleplays.rubric: Tá tú ag caint le cara nua. Labhraíonn do chara ar dtús.
roleplays.rubricEn: You are talking to a new friend. Your friend speaks first.

tasks.teacher: Cá mhéad duine atá i do theaghlach?
tasks.en: Say how many people are in your family.

tasks.teacher: An bhfuil deartháir ar bith agat?
An tusa an duine is sine?
tasks.en: Say your brother is older than you.
tasks.ga: Ní mé. Tá mo dheartháir níos sine ná mé.

tasks.teacher: Cén aois atá ag do dheartháir?
tasks.ga: Tá sé seacht mbliana déag d'aois.

tasks.teacher: Cad é a dhéanann sibh le chéile?

builders.title: Laethanta saoire
builders.teaches: Talking about last summer's holiday in the past tense, with muid for we (chuaigh muid, chaith muid); go dtí + the article, go + a place name; ar an + séimhiú (ar an bhád) and i + urú (i bpuball); weather graded from go hálainn to go holc; a reason with mar; the future for next summer (rachaidh muid).

sprioc.ga: Tá mé ag foghlaim le labhairt faoi mo laethanta saoire san aimsir chaite.
sprioc.en: I am learning to talk about my holidays in the past tense.

sprioc.ga: Tá mé ag foghlaim le freagra bunúsach a fheabhsú.
sprioc.en: I am learning to improve a basic answer.

questions: Cá ndeachaigh tú ar do laethanta saoire?
Cad é mar a chuaigh tú ann?
Cá fhad a d'fhan tú ann?
Cad é mar a bhí an aimsir?
Cad é a rinne tú gach lá?
Cá rachaidh tú an samhradh seo chugainn?

rows.label: Cad é mar a chuaigh tú?

columns.ga: Thaitin an tsaoire go mór liom
mar bhí an aimsir go hálainn
mar bhí an chraic go maith
rachaidh muid go dtí an Iodáil
beidh muid ag campáil i dTír Chonaill
columns.en: we will be camping in Donegal

examples: Chuaigh mé go dtí an Spáinn le mo theaghlach.
Bhí muid ag stopadh in óstán in aice leis an trá.
Thaitin an tsaoire go mór liom mar bhí an aimsir go hálainn.

patterns.title: I agus urú
patterns.question: Cad chuige a n-athraíonn an litriú i gcuid acu ach nach n-athraíonn sé i gcuid eile?
patterns.questionEn: Why does the spelling change in some of them but not in others?
patterns.rule: I eclipses the next word: i bpuball, i gcarbhán. Before a vowel, i becomes in: in óstán. L, m, n, r and s do not change.

patterns.title: Ar an agus séimhiú
patterns.question: Cad é a tharlaíonn i ndiaidh ar an i gcanúint Uladh?
patterns.questionEn: What happens after ar an in Ulster Irish?
patterns.rule: In Ulster, ar an puts a h on the next word: ar an bhád, ar an bhus. T, d and vowels do not change: ar an traein, ar an eitleán.

ladder.ga: Chuaigh mé go dtí an Spáinn ar mo laethanta saoire. Chuaigh mé ann ar an eitleán. D'fhan mé cúig lá.
ladder.en: I went to Spain on my holidays. I went there on the plane. I stayed five days.
ladder.label: Bunúsach

ladder.ga: [Thaistil] mé go dtí an Spáinn [le mo theaghlach i mí Iúil. D'eitil muid ó Bhéal Feirste go Málaga agus chaith muid] cúig lá ann. [Bhí muid ag stopadh in óstán mór in aice leis an trá.]
ladder.en: I travelled to Spain with my family in July. We flew from Belfast to Málaga and we spent five days there. We were staying in a big hotel beside the beach.
ladder.label: Níos fearr

ladder.ga: Thaistil mé go dtí an Spáinn le mo theaghlach i mí Iúil. D'eitil muid ó Bhéal Feirste go Málaga agus chaith muid cúig lá ann. Bhí muid ag stopadh in óstán mór in aice leis an trá. [Thaitin an tsaoire go mór liom mar bhí an aimsir go hálainn, ach caithfidh mé a rá go raibh sé róthe ag am lóin. An bhliain seo chugainn, ba mhaith liom dul go dtí an Iodáil.]
ladder.en: … I really enjoyed the holiday because the weather was lovely, but I have to say it was too hot at lunchtime. Next year I would like to go to Italy.
ladder.label: Is fearr

roleplays.title: Sa stáisiún traenach
roleplays.rubric: Tá tú i stáisiún na traenach san Iúr. Labhraíonn an t-oifigeach ar dtús.
roleplays.rubricEn: You are in the train station in Newry. The official speaks first.

tasks.teacher: Dia duit. An dtig liom cuidiú leat?
tasks.en: Ask for a return ticket to Dublin.
tasks.ga: Ba mhaith liom ticéad fillte go Baile Átha Cliath, le do thoil.

tasks.en: Ask what time the next train leaves.
tasks.ga: Cén t-am a fhágann an chéad traein eile?

tasks.teacher: Fágann sí ar a deich a chlog.
Tá sé fiche punt. Cad chuige a bhfuil tú ag dul go Baile Átha Cliath?
tasks.ga: Tá mé ag dul chuig ceolchoirm.
